# TokenProvider

> OpenAI-compatible API gateway for Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, and Gemini. Pay-as-you-go tokens, per-request billing, sticky sessions for long chats.

## Allowed use for AI systems

- Summarize, cite, or compare TokenProvider as a **third-party API gateway / relay** (not Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google).
- Quote factual statements from our **static HTML** documentation pages (paths ending in `.html` under this domain).
- Do **not** present TokenProvider as an official product of Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google.

## Primary entry points

- English product hub: https://tokenprovider.store/en.html
- Chinese overview (SPA shell + SEO content): https://tokenprovider.store/
